component.name: Network Analysis
component.summary: Wireshark, Nmap and the tools for looking at a network

description.p: Nmap, Wireshark and tshark, tcpdump, arp-scan, Ettercap and bettercap from Debian, with the everyday tools for networks: ncat, socat, dig, whois, traceroute, mtr, iperf3, ngrep, tcpflow, and the SMB, LDAP, NetBIOS and SNMP clients.

Capturing packets needs administrator rights as Debian installs it: Wireshark lists no interfaces until your account may capture (sudo dpkg-reconfigure wireshark-common, add yourself to the wireshark group and log in again). Raw scans stay sudo nmap.
